name: messaging-web-data-only-background
description: A DATA-ONLY message (no notification field) sent while the page has no visible client: onBackgroundMessage FIRES, delivering a payload with data/from/messageId and NO notification key. Auto-display probe: this is the FIRST background send of the run against a freshly-activated worker (its activate handler cleared all notifications), and the handler displays nothing, so registration.getNotifications() afterwards is attributable to this message alone — value pinned as notificationsAfterHandler. NOTE: Chrome's own userVisibleOnly "site updated in the background" fallback is a browser-level notification and may or may not surface in getNotifications(); the pinned count is the honest, directly-observed number. Cited by messaging#14 (surface climbing under CDD; cited, not yet replayed).
